---
name: Validation
about: A measurement or result might be misleading us — check it
title: "Check whether <suspected bias> skews <measurement>"
labels: validation
---

## Suspicion

What might be distorting a measurement, and the mechanism by which it would.

## What rests on it

The conclusion, constant or CLAUDE.md claim that relies on this measurement.

## Observed

Evidence so far: numbers, with the data date and how they were produced. "None yet" if the issue is only a hunch.

## Check

The measurement that settles it, plus what counts as confirmed and what counts as cleared, written down before running it.

## Outcome

- Confirmed → what changes (fix the measurement, revisit the constant).
- Cleared → close, and note it next to the claim it protects.
